problem: A cached/fallback calculation increments bufferVersion during each save. A permanently failed save therefore re-scheduled itself every 3 seconds; red test observed 10 save attempts in 30 seconds.
fix: Reuse existing PPTX failure-stop behavior: distinguish automatic and explicit saves, pause automatic source writes after a failed receipt/exception, preserve visible error across new text/cell/sheet/range edits, keep draft checkpointing, and allow explicit save or clean reload to resume. Queued automatic saves also respect the stop flag.
realIntegration: Open actual XLSX with production Worker/FileService and r8 broker; remove source write bits. First autosave fails as readonly; across 60 seconds plus new input no further source-save attempts, disk original unchanged and checkpoints retained. Restore write bits; explicit save writes once and independently reopens new local value. No fabricated success receipt.
harnessFailures: Native r1/r2 each failed because a 30-second fake timer jump timed out a still-running real Worker checkpoint. Corrected by awaiting each 500ms checkpoint before advancing the remaining 29500ms; product timeout policy unchanged. Failures retained.

aggregateLatestCodeResults.basis: Prior r8 audit plus affected re-runs, deduplicated by file + full test name; no current code-test failures, two existing external CLI probes remain opt-in.

boundaries: J08 full append/materialize stale/too-large/conflict/disconnection and permitted 1000ms retry matrix still incomplete; this fix does not mark the whole case passed.
r8 package predates DEV055; current source build/typecheck and integration passed, next consolidated App package and GUI revalidation required.
No UI layout/prototype page change. Existing failure/error/retry states retained, faulty repeated writes corrected; full visual/IME claims not made.
